notes: Personal and company finance for Acts 1-2 (GDD 7.7, 7.8). Read by sim/finance.gd.

starting_savings_usd.note: Personal savings at the start of every mode.

salary_usd_month.note: Day job take-home pay, paid on the 1st. Pays the power bill (GDD 7.7).

rehire_delay_days.note: After quitting, getting a day job back takes this long.

incorporation_cost_usd.note: Legal and filing fees. Incorporation unlocks in Act 2 (GDD 6).

incorporation_act.note: GDD 6: incorporation is an Act 2 unlock.

loan_principal_usd.note: The one small business loan (GDD 7.7, M3 scope). Needs incorporation.

loan_term_months.note: Repaid in equal monthly payments from the month after it is drawn.

living_situations.note: Rent, food and bills by living situation, owed on the 1st whether or not the player has a job. Chosen once at the start (decisions.md 2026-10-17). The Act 1 objective is mining revenue covering this.

default_living_situation.note: Used until the player chooses, and by the bots.
